# h13_passive_contention

Report issues: W6, R1.

**Source.** Hand-made SimOxide corpus model (`corpus/h13_passive_contention`, generated by refsim's `HandMade.java`). Licence: EPL-2.0 (SimOxide repository). `run.json` and `FEATURES.txt` are SimOxide metadata (`run.json` holds SimuLizar stop conditions; Slingshot uses the simulation time below).

## Model

A passive resource (capacity 2) with 6 closed users: AcquireAction, CPU demand, ReleaseAction. The Acquire/Release actions have no ParametricResourceDemand, as in most Palladio examples.

## Run with stock Slingshot

Import the folder into an Eclipse workspace with the Slingshot nightly. Create a *Slingshot Simulation* run configuration:

- Allocation Model: `h13_passive_contention.allocation`
- Usage Model: `h13_passive_contention.usagemodel`
- Monitor Repository: `h13_passive_contention.monitorrepository`
- Simulation tab: maximum simulation time **21 s**; EDP2, an in-memory repository.

The other model files are loaded through the references. Set the console log level to INFO to see the dispatched events and the handler errors (`An error occurred: …`).

The model draws no random number.

## What to look for

- `NoSuchElementException: No parametric resource demand specified for AcquireAction!` (`SeffInterpreter.java:233-234`).
- `onSeffInterpretationProgressed` is disposed at the first acquire: only 40 rows in 21 s for 6 users.

## Expected

Acquire and release one unit when no demand is given (SimuCom/SimuLizar).

## Observed (reference runner)

`observed/` holds the outputs of the SimOxide reference runner, deterministic mode, `-seed 12 -simTime 21` (appendix of `../../REPORT.md`): `errors.txt`, `measurements.csv`, `projection-m.jsonl`, `summary.json`.
`errors.txt` lists the handler exceptions (`exception: message | first Slingshot frame`), one per disposed handler; `measurements.csv` the EDP2 rows (`measuring_point,metric,time,value`); `projection*.jsonl` the dispatched model-level events (users, calls, jobs, measurements, SPD events; `projection-m.jsonl` without passed elements and jobs).

Headless (optional, from `reference/slingshot/`):

```sh
./run.sh --stock -model upstream-report/reproductions/h13_passive_contention -out /tmp/h13_passive_contention -simTime 21
./run.sh         -model upstream-report/reproductions/h13_passive_contention -out /tmp/h13_passive_contention-det -simTime 21 -seed 12   # deterministic
```
